description: Search Atlas | Product Engineer (PM) | REMOTE (anywhere, EST hours) | Full-time | $23-34/hr We're ~160 people building an AI marketing platform. Our main product, OTTO, runs a site's SEO on its own: it reads live search data and ships the technical and on-page fixes itself. Customers include Autotrader, Hyundai, P&G and Vendasta. Pods are 1 PM and 2-4 engineers. You own your pod's roadmap and ship it with them, with no veteran PM signing off on your specs. You have 3+ years as a B2B SaaS PM with a real technical background (eng or QA before PM, or you already work in the codebase). You read Python and TS, write your own SQL, and don't need an engineer to explain a stack trace. Stack is Django + React/Next. QA is yours end to end, release sign-off included. You use Claude Code or similar daily. Apply (mention HN): https://careers.searchatlas.com/jobs/599248-product-engineer... Also hiring: * Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Django/Next.js) $25-$30/hr: https://careers.searchatlas.com/jobs/595729-senior-full-stac... * SEO Automation Engineer (Python) $17-$28/hr: https://careers.searchatlas.com/jobs/559066-seo-automation-e... * All roles: https://careers.searchatlas.com Please apply through the links, not by email. No agencies. Location: our ATS makes us list specific countries, but we hire anywhere you can work EST hours. If your country isn't listed, apply anyway.
